rubrics.justification: Generally consistent with a good-quality blastocyst and correctly notes image focus limitations, but it infers hatching/zona thinning and strong TE detail that are not clearly visible on this single image; also appropriately flags the 4AA vs 5AA grading inconsistency.
Thoroughly integrates maternal age, ovarian reserve, tubal factor, prior IVF outcomes, endometrium, BMI, lifestyle, and paternal/semen factors with embryo quality and prognosis.
Reasoning is logical and well structured, with conclusions mostly supported by the case details; only minor overreach comes from morphology-based assumptions not fully supported by the image.

Recommendations are largely evidence-based and aligned with IVF practice, including SET, hydrosalpinx attention, uterine reassessment, and cautious use of PGT-A; minor limitation is some speculative emphasis on sperm DNA fragmentation without stronger indication.
Provides clear, practical next steps for the current transfer and contingency planning for failed transfer or miscarriage, with appropriate nuance and prioritization.
